name: 6612-fixedlen-8bawq-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- a single card.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 2.5 req/s, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -- about 160 s of offered load and ~280 measured requests.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain` (raw completion string, no chat template), fixed by construction: every request is exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 512 output tokens. Sampling is temperature 0.0, greedy.
purpose: A Llama 3 8B completion service extending 1024-token documents by 512 tokens under random arrivals at 2.5 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
model: casperhansen/llama-3-8b-instruct-awq
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
